key_notes: Key 1 (t=5.86s): Initial archival pose of arm; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=6.99s): Mid-sequence articulation of arm; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=8.22s): Peak dynamic extension of arm over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=9.46s): Follow-through and settle of arm with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of arm (5.86s..9.46s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
